reference_sql:
SELECT c.parent_category, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE s.country_code = 'BE' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
GROUP BY c.parent_category
alternatives: SELECT c.parent_category, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM stores s JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE s.country_code = 'BE' AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31' GROUP BY c.parent_category

WITH be_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE s.country_code = 'BE' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01') SELECT c.parent_category, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM be_orders b JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = b.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.parent_category

solver.query:
SELECT c.parent_category, SUM(l.quantity) AS units
FROM order_lines l
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE s.country_code = 'BE'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY c.parent_category
